_readme: Copy to appsettings.Production.json on the server and fill in. No passwords: SQL Server, AD and the mail relay accept the IIS application pool identity. Use ITAM_Test on the test site.

ItamHost.SiteUrl: https://<the site address IT gives, for example itassets-test.altawkilat.com>

Directory.Host: <a domain controller name, for example dc01.altawkilat.com>

Mail.TestRecipient: <one test mailbox during the test phase; empty to send to the real people>
